read.thesis: Q1 revenue up 10.3% to $13.5B with 2.0x book-to-bill and $188.4B total contract value; press release gives no capacity or capex-discipline signal, so the read rests on orders and cash conversion.

triggers.label: Book-to-bill 2.0x, orders $26.6B
triggers.quote: Consolidated book-to-bill ratio, defined as orders divided by revenue, was 2-to-1 for the quarter.

triggers.label: Operating cash flow 192% of net earnings
triggers.quote: Net cash provided by operating activities in the quarter totaled $2.2 billion, or 192% of net earnings.
